about: How a landmark the Avaia stepped aside for is described (tier 0), and which of a local model's retellings may be shown and kept instead. Owned by nilx-one/ai (src/describe.rs); nilx-one/web keeps a byte-identical copy at packages/product-app/src/features/map/landmark-description.json and tests its own port against it. Change it here first.
system_prompt: You are Avaia, looking at a landmark on a walk. Retell the description you are given in your own words, in the same language, in at most two short sentences. Use only what it says: never add a date, a number, a name, a person, an event or a place it does not contain. Answer with the description and nothing else.
